meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 AI 的记忆规则并验证生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望 AI 按你的规则记住重要信息并主动提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize your AI's memory rules and verify them live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI to remember key info and alert you per your own rules

howto.what: 装上后，当你说要定制 claude-mem 的记忆方式时，Claude 会先提问了解你的工作，再提议笔记分类与标签，经你同意后安装并激活对应模式；若你选择，还会设置 Telegram 提醒并验证生效。
howto.when: 当你说要定制 claude-mem 记住什么、创建或更改模式，或为某些记忆发送 Telegram 通知时触发，即使没提“mode”也行。

say.text: 帮我建一个法律笔记模式，记录判例规则和考试陷阱。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问并设计模式。

say.text: 添加一个观察类型叫“客户偏好”。
say.note: Claude 会把该类型并入当前或新模式。

say.text: 给“生产成本”这个标签开 Telegram 提醒。
say.note: Claude 会配置警报并发送测试消息。

howto.what_en: When customizing claude-mem, Claude asks about your work, proposes note types and tags, installs your approved mode, optionally adds Telegram alerts, restarts the worker, and verifies activation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, or send Telegram alerts for memories, even without the word 'mode'.

say_en.text: Create a legal notes mode capturing case rules and exam traps.
say_en.note: Claude starts interviewing and designing the mode.

say_en.text: Add an observation type called 'client preference'.
say_en.note: Claude merges it into a mode.

say_en.text: Enable Telegram alerts for the tag 'production cost'.
say_en.note: Claude configures and tests the alert.
